name: smwmusic-deltarune-gingerbread-house
title: Deltarune - Gingerbread House
description:
The song "Gingerbread House" from Chapter 4 of Deltarune, which plays in Noelle's house, originally composed by Toby Fox. Would fit in chill snow levels or snowy overworlds.

The original samples were found using stormstudios1's Deltarune Sample Sheet.
